item.title: T. Rowe Price AUM Drops to $1.71 Trillion: What Investors Need to Know
item.description:
$3.2 billion walked out the door in a single month. That’s the reality T. Rowe Price Group (NASDAQ: TROW) is facing as the Baltimore-based asset management giant reported its March 2026 assets under management fell to $1.71 trillion, down from the previous month amid persistent market headwinds and investor outflows.

Key Takeaways

  • T. Rowe Price reported $1.71 trillion in AUM for March 2026, a month-over-month decline
  • $3.2 billion in net outflows hit the firm in March alone
  • Goldman Sachs set a new price target of $85.00 — well below the current trading price
  • The stock closed at $95.84, up 1.56% on the day and 8% over the past month
  • 2025 revenue reached $7.31 billion (+3.12% YoY), but earnings dipped slightly to $2.04 billion (-0.38%)

So what’s really happening at one of America’s oldest independent asset managers, and should investors be concerned? Let’s break it down.

item.title: T. Rowe Price Expands Into CLOs: What This Bold Move Means for Investors
item.description:
A firm managing $1.80 trillion in assets just made its first move into one of the most talked-about corners of fixed income — and it could reshape how investors think about this 85-year-old giant.

Key Takeaways

  • T. Rowe Price has entered the collateralized loan obligation (CLO) market with a $403.6 million debut deal
  • The firm is battling structural outflows as investors shift toward lower-cost ETFs
  • A strategic partnership with Goldman Sachs is opening doors to private market solutions
  • Despite headwinds, T. Rowe Price is aggressively diversifying its fixed income platform

T. Rowe Price Launches Its First CLO — A $403.6 Million Statement

T. Rowe Price announced in April 2026 that it is expanding its fixed income investment platform with a brand-new collateralized loan obligation (CLO) offering. The debut deal clocks in at $403.6 million in bank loans, marking the firm’s entrance into the CLO issuance market for the first time.

item.title: T. Rowe Price Shakes Up Investing With Crypto ETF and Credit Fund Launches
item.description:
A firm with 85 years of investment history is now betting on dogecoin, shiba inu, and 13 other digital assets — and that’s just the beginning of what T. Rowe Price has been up to this month.

Key Takeaways

  • T. Rowe Price filed an amended SEC registration for a 15-asset actively managed crypto ETF, one of the first of its kind in the U.S.
  • The firm launched OFLEX, a multi-strategy credit interval fund with Oak Hill Advisors covering both public and private credit markets.
  • T. Rowe Price expanded its global retirement leadership team with key new appointments to strengthen its retirement capabilities.
  • The firm manages over $1.6 trillion in assets as of December 31, 2025.

T. Rowe Price Crypto ETF: 15 Digital Assets Under Active Management

The Baltimore-based asset manager submitted an amended S-1 registration to the SEC in March 2026 for the Price Active Crypto ETF — a product that could become one of the first actively managed cryptocurrency exchange-traded funds in the United States.
